verses.1: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.2: Man said to your people, “I will bring destruction upon this land.” Then one man from among them was chosen and given to them as a hostage.
verses.3: And he saw that the locusts had come upon the earth. They settled in the trees and spread over the entire land. He warned the people about this.
verses.4: And the ear heard the sound of the trumpet, but it did not warn anyone. Then disaster came and took him away, with his blood on his head.
verses.5: He heard the voice of the shepherd, but he did not heed it. His soul became fearful because of that.
verses.6: And when the worm came and tried to enter, it didn’t get stuck in the wood. The people weren’t careful, and the worm entered. It took their lives. He was taken away, and his blood was drained from him by the worm.
verses.7: And you, son of man, you who were sent into the house of Israel, you heard what they said. You remembered them from among me.
verses.8: In my words, the wicked will die and become no more. You did not warn the wicked about their ways. They are truly wicked; they will die, and their blood will be shed by your hand.
verses.9: And you, who have been warned as a wicked person, from returning from that path. You will not return from your wrong path. You will die in your sin, and your soul will be saved.
verses.10: And you, son of Adam, say to the house of Israel, “Thus do we say: Our sins and transgressions have overwhelmed us. We are in a state of ruin. How can we live?”
verses.11: Say to them, “I am the living God. O Lord Jehovah! May I not abandon the wicked in their deaths? Or should they be allowed to return from their evil paths? Come back from your evil ways! Why do you remain in the house of Israel?”
verses.12: And you, son of man, say to your people, “The righteous will not be saved from their sins. The wicked will not be punished for their evil deeds. But when they turn from their sins, the righteous will not be able to live in them anymore.”
verses.13: In saying this to the righteous, he will live on. He will surely be saved through his righteousness. He has done all that is right in his life; no one will remember those deeds. And in his actions, he will die.
verses.14: And in my words, the wicked will die and return from their sins. They will do justice and righteousness.
verses.15: The wicked will be punished by God’s laws. They will not be able to do anything; they will live forever, and they will not die.
verses.16: All his sins, which he committed, will not be remembered by judgment and righteousness. He will live on.
verses.17: And your children said, “It is not possible to go through Adonai’s path. Their path is also impossible.”
verses.18: Once again, he was righteous in his righteousness. But he did evil, and he died in them.
verses.19: And once again, the wicked will be freed from their evil ways. He will judge and act justly among them. Then he will live.
verses.20: And you said, “It is not possible for a man to walk through the path of Adonai, just as he cannot save you from the house of Israel.”
verses.21: And it was after twelve years, on the fifteenth day of the month, that we were brought out. It was when the exile from Jerusalem began to take place.
verses.22: And the hand of Jehovah was upon me in the evening, before I went out. It opened its mouth for me in the morning. It opened its mouth, and I did not die again.
verses.24: These people who dwell in the ruins are saying, “One was Abraham, who inherited this land. We are many; we have been given this land as our inheritance.”
verses.25: Therefore, say to them this: “Oh Lord Jehovah, on the blood! You shall eat it, and your eyes shall see your enemies. You shall shed their blood, and the earth will be filled with their blood.”
verses.26: You stood on the ruins of your own houses, causing harm to others. You defiled the wife of your neighbors. And the land will be desolate.
verses.27: “Thus shall I say to them: ‘Thus said Adonai YHWH: If not for those who are destroyed in the ruins, and those who lie in the fields for food, and those who die by the words spoken in the wilderness, then what would remain?’”
verses.28: And I will give to this land its former state and its original beauty. The mountains of Israel will be filled with fertility once again.
verses.29: And they shall know that I, Jehovah, have given them the land that was desolate and barren, so that they could no longer suffer any more from their sins.
verses.30: And you, son of man, you are among your people, those who are spoken to by God through the walls and at the entrances of the houses. You must speak to one person about his brother, saying, “Come here.” And they must listen to what is said by God.
verses.31: And they will come to you, just as a people does. They will sit before you. They will hear your words. But they won’t do what you say, because those who do this act it in their hearts, according to their own desires.
verses.32: And you will be to them like a beautiful song with a pleasant melody. They will hear your words and do what you say.
verses.33: And when she came, they knew that there was indeed a prophet among them.
